newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cr Foncier freezes asset sales.
newsitem.headline: Cr Foncier freezes asset sales.

text.p: French property bank Credit Foncier de France has decided to suspend its program of asset sales while it is looking for a buyer, Chairman Jerome Meyssonnier said on Friday.
"It is important to find a buyer who will decide whether to keep or not these properties," he told a news conference, adding that 1996 had seen a recovery in rents on Credit Foncier's properties.
Credit Foncier would sell "very few" buildings in the next four or five months, he said. The bank is looking for a buyer to bail it out after making a 1995 net loss of 10.6 billion francs.
It reported on Thursday 1996 consolidated profit of 866 million.
